# Error budget (generated by studies/error_budget.py; do not edit)

Reference: t_gate 50 ns, dEz 100 MHz, J_idle 50 kHz, Stark 1e8 Hz/V on Q2, 1/f recalibrated below 0.01 Hz. Each entry: the largest error of that kind alone that keeps the infidelity added after calibration at the target. Signed errors: the worse sign. Glitch 'start': step-and-decay transient that begins as the CZ starts (refresh of this electrode just before the gate). 'mid': begins at mid-gate (crosstalk from refreshing another electrode on the same line).
